# Watt Audio

Watt Audio is an iOS app that turns supported story links into chapter audio using AI voice generation, background playback, speed control, sleep timer, and offline replay for generated audio.

## Primary Pages
- [English homepage](https://wattaudios.com/en/): Product overview and App Store download link.
- [Vietnamese homepage](https://wattaudios.com/vi/): Tổng quan sản phẩm và link tải App Store.
- [About Watt Audio](https://wattaudios.com/about.html): Product entity page with features, audience, app description, and download link.
- [Support](https://wattaudios.com/support.html): Quick start, troubleshooting, and contact details.
- [Privacy Policy](https://wattaudios.com/privacy.html): Privacy, local storage, generated audio, and network use.
